scripts.dev: npm run build -w @xeetcode/shared && concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @xeetcode/web" "npm run dev -w @xeetcode/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @xeetcode/shared && npm run build -w @xeetcode/server && npm run build -w @xeetcode/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @xeetcode/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present

comments.overrides: monaco-editor pins an older dompurify carrying XSS advisories; the patched line is API-compatible.
